stack.label: 04 / TECHNOLOGY
stack.meta: THE RIGHT TOOLS. THE RIGHT REASONS.
stack.headline: MY TOOLBOX.
descriptions: Thoughtful types. Clear contracts. Fewer surprises.
Composable interfaces with state that stays predictable.
Routes, rendering and data, brought into one coherent product.
Services and APIs that connect the parts of a product.
Relational data, explicit schemas and dependable queries.
Geometry, materials and light for expressive browser experiences.

process.label: FROM FIRST QUESTION TO FINAL DETAIL
headline: HOW
I BUILD.
descriptions: Ask better questions. Understand the purpose, the people and the problem before opening the editor.
Find the visual language. Shape the flow, prototype the interactions and make every detail earn its place.
Build the system behind the feeling. Bring design and code together with performance and accessibility in mind.
Test the real experience. Refine the rough edges, release thoughtfully and keep learning.
